heroTitle: The flagship forum for steel reuse
heroLede: Circular Steel UK is the industry's leading event dedicated to making structural steel reuse viable at scale. Held annually in London, it brings together the organisations delivering the UK's most significant reuse projects alongside the policymakers, designers and supply chain leaders enabling market growth.
focusIntro: The UK market sits at the forefront of practical steel reuse. Circular Steel UK reflects this maturity — moving beyond theory and into technical, commercial and regulatory delivery. The event focuses on:
whoAttends: Circular Steel UK attracts senior decision-makers and technical specialists from across the built environment ecosystem, creating a uniquely focused and collaborative forum. The event is supported by leading organisations across engineering, construction and materials, reflecting a shared commitment to accelerating reuse in practice.
